lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Nice job, everyone!

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: With this, we'll be able to collate all the data into one place.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: The surface really does have everything you need.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: That means we can take Hermin back to the Ark.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: His condition isn't very good.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: We need to hurry.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: How long will it take to transfer the data?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I can't say for sure. The read and write speed will be quite slow.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I just have to see what happens.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: ... Okay. Do whatever you can.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Well, I'll get started on the data transfer.

lines.speaker: ce006_03
lines.text: Meanwhile, Elegg and Privaty, can you show everyone else what you found?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: ... Yeah.
What did you find?

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Everyone. Come here.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why'd you have to bring us here to show whatever it is you want to show us?

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: While you all went to look for a storage device, Ms. Lily and I recovered a lot of footage.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Or rather, the audio, to be precise. There was no way to restore the video.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: We've organized it in chronological order. We would like all of you to listen.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Here we go.
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: It's a shame we couldn't preserve everything, but we managed to digitize most of it.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: This bunker is now humanity's last artistic bastion.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: My fellow artists, we must be proud and carry on!

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: The Ark will come to rescue us soon!
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: There were five of them...

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: I understand why they did it. It's dark in here, Raptures are constantly swarming outside, and there's a lack of proper facilities in the bunker.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: But they could have at least told us they were leaving. Instead, they ran off without even taking any proper food or clothes...

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: I hope they arrive safely. I hope that they survive.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Has the Ark reached out, you ask?

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: No, not yet.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Do-don't worry. Humanity will win soon enough, and then they'll come to save us.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Don't you remember how much they adored us? How they exalted us as artists who had stood up to the Raptures?
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: It was seven this time.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: We swore to protect these artworks no matter what, even with our lives, if necessary.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: There still hasn't been any contact.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: They haven't forgotten about us, have they?

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: They couldn't have abandoned us...

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Could they?

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: No, wait! Don't rip that!

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: I know it's cold, but you can't burn that cloth, or the wooden statue! You know as well as I do that they're precious pieces of art.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: We have to hold out. We're here to look after these precious works of art, not our own well-being.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: We are artists, and our mission is to protect art! We must remember that!
*Buzz*
*Bang bang bang bang*

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Do you hear that? Someone's knocking on the door!

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: You see? I told you they wouldn't abandon us!

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: I'm opening the door!

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: ... Huh?
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: How dare you come back after abandoning this place?!

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: You realized there was nothing out there, didn't you? That's why you came back.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: I see... Raptures got everyone... and there are swarms of them nearby...

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Then tell me, why did you abandon our art?

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Pr... pregnant?
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: I-I can't! I've never delivered a baby before!

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Even if I know how it was done in practice, actually doing it is completely different!

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Gah! Th-the head is crowning!

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Get me some warm water and a towel, hurry!

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: What?! We don't have any... Right, right. We're lacking in basic essentials here.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Chop up the wooden statue and start a fire. Boil the drinking water and sterilize the cloth.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: Forget about the artwork, the baby is about to die!
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: I'm sorry, everyone.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: From now on, our principal duty is no longer to protect the art,

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: but simply to stay alive.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: A baby girl was born.

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: We can't show her the world outside the bunker,

lines.speaker: younghermin
lines.text: but we can at least ensure she stays alive.
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Oh, this?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: This is by a painter who is known as a tragic figure. The colors are so vivid, aren't they?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: This technique and style failed to gain recognition in the artist's lifetime, and their work was only reevaluated after their death.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: What's the point of being recognized only after you're dead?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Hehe... it's about leaving something for the future.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: To pass something on and influence later generations is a crowning artistic achievement.
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: You must not whine like that. It's a hellish place outside this bunker.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: People like us wouldn't last a day out there.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: ... I understand. I understand that you want to see the outside world.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: But... you are our daughter.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: None of us want to lose you.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Everyone here is staying alive for your sake. I hope you will realize that one day.
*Buzz*
*Bang bang bang bang*

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: ... Who is it?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I said who is it?!

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Nikkes!

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Nikkes are here to save us! Finally!
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: ... I see. Deserters.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I can't believe suicide missions have become so common... How did it come to this?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Well, don't worry.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I'm the one who created this bunker. I don't mean to brag, but it's top-notch.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: It hasn't been discovered by Raptures yet, and we have an independent power generator, water purification, and air circulation system which guarantees our survival.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: We also have plenty of food left. There's enough here to last 20 people for a century.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: You can stay as long as you like.
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: You're more versatile than I thought, Com.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I feel we can truly count on you.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I can't thank you enough for spending time with our daughter and playing with her.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: She really likes you.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Excuse me, Nikkes. I have a favor to ask of you.
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: My daughter, listen carefully.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: You were out wandering the surface, and these Nikkes found you.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Do you understand? You weren't born in this bunker, but on the surface, where these Nikkes rescued you.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: This way, they won't be labeled as deserters.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: They can say that it simply took time to rescue you and keep you safe.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Do you understand? Don't... Don't cry, and look at me.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: We can't go together. You are the only one they can protect.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Go to the Ark. Go and live a normal life.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Don't spend your life in a dark and dingy place like this, subsisting on canned food and metallic-tasting water.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Go live somewhere where it's bright and comfortable, and where the food is delicious.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Understand?
*Buzz*
*Rumble rumble rumble rumble*

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: The drainage system is blocked? That means this place will be flooded!

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: No! The artwork! All the data!

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: What? What did you say?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Weld the door shut? No, absolutely not!

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: It's too dangerous! I refuse! We have to give up everything and go back...

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Can... can we really give up on all of this?

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: These are priceless artifacts which must be preserved and passed on.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I will remain here.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Someone needs to stay here and manage the facility.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Go ahead and weld the door shut from the outside. I will stay.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Yes, the data here is more important than my own life.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Come to me, my darling. My beautiful daughter.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I know this is all so sudden, but it's time to say goodbye.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I... I'm so happy that you were a part of my life.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I am someone who has dedicated their whole life to art, and you are the finest masterpiece I have laid eyes on.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I love you.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Com. Please take care of her. Promise me.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Now go. Get out, and weld the door shut.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I'll protect this place no matter what, so don't worry.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Just take care of our daughter, please.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: And... please, everyone...

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Come back for me. I'll be waiting.
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: I have to open it.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Something's happened. I'm sure of it. I need to open it.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Oh... right. It was... welded shut.

lines.speaker: middlehermin
lines.text: Th-they'll come. They'll come to save me. They promised.
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: How long has it been?

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: ... 30 years.

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: They won't come.
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: Urgh...
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: hermin
lines.text: It's lonely in here...
*Buzz*
*Buzz*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That girl...

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: We looked into it, but couldn't find any data on her.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Same with the Nikkes who deserted.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: It's been so long, and...

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: There's a high chance that they never made it to the Ark.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: We're still looking into it, although we're not sure if we'll turn up anything.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: So those three dead Nikkes we found outside...

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: Are most likely the Nikkes who deserted, yes.

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: This entire place would have been flooding while they were trying to weld the door, until eventually...

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: To protect what was contained in this bunker, they made the ultimate sacrifice.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: I checked the files and closely examined the one whose arm was severed.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: It looks like she used her own arm as welding material.
So that's what happened...

lines.speaker: ce006_01
lines.text: What painfully sad memories.
... Let's hurry.
We need to move as quickly as possible.
Let's take both Hermin and all the data to the Ark. Don't leave a single thing behind.
